title: Berkeley Housing Pipeline Database
description: 1,544 housing projects rebuilt from primary sources (CPRA permit feeds, City Accela records, Alameda County assessor, Rent Board registry, CTCAC). Regenerated by scripts/gen_datasette_dbs.py from the canonical v4 database.
source: City of Berkeley (Accela, CPRA productions, Rent Board), Alameda County assessor, CTCAC

berkeley_housing_map.title: Housing Pipeline (1,544 projects)
berkeley_housing_map.description: From the canonical v4 database's serving views. Organizations are named; private individuals are not (publishing rule, 2026-10-01).

projects.title: Projects (1,544)
projects.description: One row per project (v4 v_projects). project_key is the stable public id (anchor Planning record, else first master permit). Status, units, tiers, pathways and dates come from sources; see the methodology for each.

timeline.title: Timeline (12,183)
timeline.description: Each project's Planning records and building-permit events, dated as the City recorded them.

people.title: People and organizations, by role (12,607)
people.description: Every role from its own record: owner of record (County roll), permit owner and contractors (building permit pages), architect and engineers (plan title blocks), property manager and rental owner (Rent Board), developer and general partners (CTCAC), funders (funding ledger), City reviewers and inspectors. Private individuals are shown as 'individual owner' or 'individual'.

businesses.title: Licensed businesses at each project (282)
businesses.description: City business licenses (2025-11-15 export) on a project's parcels or addresses. The export lacks some tenants that permits show, so no license does not mean vacant.

city_records.title: City records at each project's buildings (9,289)
city_records.description: Every Accela Building and Planning listing at the project's building addresses (tenant improvements, business certificates, signs, short-term rentals). in_project = 1 when the record is one of the project's own.

adu_rent_board.title: ADUs in the Rent Board registry (684)
adu_rent_board.description: Each ADU at one of three strengths: board_labelled_adu (the Board labels the unit ADU), parcel_registrations (units on the parcel, none labeled ADU), no_registration_found (NOT 'not rented'). Tenancy start shown as the year.

permits.title: Building permits (2,445)
permits.description: Master, phase and attached permits of each project's buildings, with submitted / issued / finaled dates and the model-read housing role.

parcels.title: Parcels and assessed values (1,559)
parcels.description: Each project's current parcels (County lineage) and the assessor's current values.

documents.title: Documents (263)
documents.description: Plan sets, applications and forms held in R2, with SHA-256.

berkeley_address_centric.title: All Berkeley Addresses (62,226)
berkeley_address_centric.description: Every Berkeley address linked to housing activity

addresses.title: Master Address Table
addresses.description: 62,226 Berkeley addresses with APNs and coordinates

address_lookup.title: Address Lookup
address_lookup.sql: SELECT a.address_full, a.apn, a.zipcode, a.latitude, a.longitude, p.net_units, p.status FROM addresses a LEFT JOIN projects p ON a.address_id = p.address_id WHERE a.base_address LIKE '%' || :address || '%' LIMIT 100

addresses_by_zipcode.title: Addresses by Zipcode
addresses_by_zipcode.sql: SELECT zipcode, COUNT(*) as addresses, COUNT(DISTINCT street_name) as streets FROM addresses GROUP BY zipcode ORDER BY addresses DESC
